title: apparule.payments.provider_event
description: common (outbox) -> commerce, on cuelabs.requests. A Paystack webhook whose signature common verified and whose raw body it stored (S-12). common attaches the order the reference points at (a lookup, not a decision); commerce decides whether the event settles it. Key: provider event id.

event.description: Paystack's event name, e.g. charge.success, transfer.success, transfer.failed, refund.processed.

order.description: The order whose payment reference matches payload.reference, or null when none does.

payment.description: The amount the checkout for this reference was started with; a charge settles only against it.
